note: Splits the ISP metric fan-out into query-building, collection and row-derivation helpers; IspSendingMetrics stays a hand-built class, no boto3 SES type imported.
Item serializer becomes a DataclassSerializer over FeatureFlagRequestUsage with help_text via extra_kwargs, keeps the component name, re-exports the dataclass, list() serializes via it.
Replaces the literal custom_agent ai_stage string with the STEP_CUSTOM_AGENT constant.
Adds Prometheus write/violation counters and a once-per-write bypass counter; the incoming field still validates structurally, so the double pass and double log remain.
Scanner takes run-wide ConditionAnalyses as a parameter and only derives the per-chunk projection; prepare/execute build it once per run; stale comment replaced.
Renames live_* counts and JSON keys to compared_*, redefining the concept (also excludes encrypted and structurally invalid flags) rather than adopting the evaluable name.
Switches the stalled-schedules gauge from livemax to livemostrecent and rewrites the comment, dropping the beat-pod wording.
Condition set card now computes rollout via the shared rolloutOf helper instead of an inline null-to-100 fallback.
Adds a separate sweep_keys_not_claimed_total counter for rescheduled/cancelled keys, keeping sweep_keys_dropped_total summable as lost evictions only.
Extracts a shared verifyScopedWorkflowJwt helper used by reschedule and cancel routes, and replaces hand-rolled body checks with a zod schema.
Moves verify_marker_topic into app::completion with a typed error carrying operator guidance, shared by daemon and CLI, backed by a new metadata-only reachability probe.
BatchingPipeline feed accepts a batch context returned from next; gRPC stream id and seq move from element context into GrpcBatchContext.
in_op test helper now delegates to compare(needle, haystack, OP_IN).
Introduces a frozen QueryRun dataclass holding the shared run fields and event properties, passed to reporting/execution helpers instead of long kwarg lists.
Pinner drops its private _is_action and uses an is_action_key helper exported from parity/eligibility.py.
Removes the handrolled session_reset, dialog_expired and state_snapshot extension events; PiExtensionError now derives from the SDK ExtensionError type.
Replaces the hand-rolled chevron expand/collapse rows with nested LemonCollapse panels.
Adds a shared TrinoCompilationBudget node budget used by scalar CTE and select-alias lowerers, plus a max generated SQL length check in the Trino printer.
Router onExtensionEvent subscription now just delegates to a PiSessionService extensionEvents(taskId, signal) method; iteration logic removed from router.
Drops the private ModelCost interface and imports the canonical one from providers/types; documents why cache_write_1h_token has no sync pair.
